lastCompletedStory.title: Retrofit 2026-06 build-notes markers + document marking convention

nextStoryContext: US-004 retrofitted the 5 already-identified one-time 2026-06 build-notes bullets in scripts/cam/patterns.md (ink-testing-library keypress simulation, tmux window-resized resize-pane -x clamp, ink-testing-library setState re-render timing, chalk.level/ANSI in ink-testing-library, Ink 7 ESC pending-buffer) with the `- [resolved 2026-06] **title** ...` marker (marker immediately after the leading `- `, matching src/commands/patterns-archive.ts's exported RESOLVED_MARKER_RE = /\[resolved \d{4}-\d{2}\]/ and the oracle's `^- \[resolved 2026-06\]` anchor). Durable invariants (Bun runtime, permission-mode, claude -p forbidden, noUncheckedIndexedAccess, Ink success/failure glyph, single-hub dispatch, sidecar-supervisor, plus other non-2026-06 bullets like the CAM-186 bun-version skip and the CAM-201 retirement note) were left unmarked by design. Documented the marking convention in BOTH scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md (added under 'Knowledge-Layer Routing', after the Location convention paragraph) and templates/scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md (added under 'Codebase Patterns (durable wisdom)', since the template copy has no Knowledge-Layer Routing section at all -- it is a generic placeholder-driven template for downstream `cam init` projects, not a byte-identical mirror; confirmed via diff before editing, consistent with the CAM-123 'cam dual-copy is per-file' pattern). Re-ran `bun run embed-vendor` to regenerate src/vendor/_generated.ts and confirmed embed-vendor:check is clean. This story did NOT run `cam patterns archive` itself (that command already exists from US-001/US-002/US-003 of this same PRD); the next real archive run (manual `cam patterns archive` invocation, or the best-effort --cycle-close auto-invoke wired in US-003) will now have real marked content to move for the first time. No further stories are known to remain in this PRD as of this handoff; if prd.json shows none with passes:false (excluding requires:operator), the next implementer should emit PRD_COMPLETE immediately per the standard selection query.
